planning_controls.value: 2027–28 provisional; 14 November 2027 is a planning deadline, not an official date.
April–June: 5 days × 2 classes. July–15 October: 6 days × 2, plus a third class Tuesday and Thursday (draft weekdays).
15 October target retained. 253 teaching + 52 practice = 305 classes. After 28 exclusion slots, 317 net slots leave 12 overall.
Eight practice sessions removed: August 2, September 6. Retained lesson dates are unchanged; actual closures still require date-level checking.
10 scheduled days / 28 class slots reserved through 15 October. Weekends already excluded. Later school/board breaks remain unbudgeted.
Weekend chapter map added: 70 tests / 85.75 hours at a 210-minute weekend cap. Draft finish 2027-11-14; spillover requires a decision before locking.
Quant practice 27; Verbal 13; LR 7; DI 5. Removed classroom practice topics remain taught; question sets are reassigned to DPP/homework.
No Foundations buffer, separate revision or catch-up blocks. Unused calendar slots are headroom, not new curriculum classes.
R1 and V1 start in April. Reading, vocabulary recall and DPP continue as homework, not extra counted classes.
LR teaching order preserved. Combined practice follows all its prerequisites.
DI starts in June. Higher maths starts in July after algebra/functions, with prerequisites retained.
Fill dates, faculty, actual minutes and status. Mark teaching, tests and discussions separately; hours alone do not prove completion.
Enter applicable test IDs in the lesson rows. Combined chapter tests may map to several rows.
User-approved practice removal in place of shifting classes earlier. Eight removed sessions are listed below for homework tracking.
14 November 2027 is provisional, not verified. If the intended exam cycle differs, this calendar must be recalculated.
Standalone workbook only. Existing Google spreadsheets have not been edited.

capacity_math.derivation: gross slots = 157 regular teaching days x 2 classes + 31 third classes = 345; net = 345 - 28 excluded slots = 317; planned = 305 classes; headroom 345-305 = 40 before exclusions, 12 after.
capacity_math.caveat: Capacity totals do not prove a feasible dated schedule; assessments are not proved to fit these slots.

weekend_rules.detail: Tests on Saturday; discussion on Sunday in the listed order. Confirm paper review and overnight evaluation before release.
Saturday teaching times and examiner availability are not confirmed. These are dated duration blocks, not room/faculty bookings.
Includes test and discussion time across BOTH days. Breaks and evaluation labour are additional, not student contact time.
Planned topic completion includes relevant retained classroom practice. Complete assigned DPP and verify actual teaching before administering a test.
A and B are distinct question papers on the same scope, never on the same weekend.
Ten undated teaching-day exclusions remain in the budget. No particular weekend is declared closed; September/October dates are flagged. Reschedule if actual closures overlap.
Chapter tests only. The 30 sectionals and 70 full mocks are not scheduled here; they must share remaining capacity, not be added above the weekend cap.
Chapter groupings and individual timings are proposed within preserved subject budgets. QT25 has 60 test minutes plus 30 discussion minutes. Dates require manual remapping if teaching moves.
This draft completes on 2027-11-14; not a proof of the earliest possible finish. 12 tests remain after 15 October; 1 remain after 10 November.
Do not increase weekend hours or cut tests automatically. Resolve spillover against the intended IIMB deadline and mock allocation before locking.
